summary: Added sdk/fleet/audit.py: Incident, AuditReport (accounts_checked, events_checked, clean, by_rule, to_json) and audit_fleet with rules foreign-event, unregistered-account, attempt-id-reused (within and across journals), overlapping-attempts (touching windows allowed) and budget-exceeded (epoch-aligned periods; omitted starbux budget is 0). 7 tests in tests/test_fleet_audit.py. Documented in docs/baseline/fleet-audit.md.

contract_status_changes.before: Nothing checked journals for cross-account events, reused attempts, concurrent attempts or overspend
contract_status_changes.after: An audit reports each isolation or budget incident with its rule, account and attempt ids

residual_risks: Budget periods are epoch-aligned windows, while the orchestrator counts a rolling period; the two can disagree near a boundary.
